title: Pre-Hardmode Melee
summary: High defense, close-range damage. Beat Skeletron and the Wall of Flesh with heavy hitters and strong armor.

weapons.label: Muramasa — fast early-game sword (found in Gold Chests / Golden Lock Boxes)
Night's Edge — combine Muramasa, Fiery Greatsword, Blade of Grass, and Light's Bane/Blood Butcherer at a Demon/Crimson Altar
Starfury — Sky Crate drop, strong AoE ranged-melee hybrid, good vs Skeletron

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — no knockback + fire immunity
Cloud in a Bottle — extra jump
Hermes Boots — movement speed
Band of Regeneration — passive healing
Feral Claws — melee speed and knockback
Philosopher's Stone — faster potion cooldown
Shield of Cthulhu (Crimson alt to Obsidian Shield) — dash + no knockback, if farmed

notes: Full loadout: Molten Armor set + Night's Edge (or Starfury for the Skeletron fight) + the 7 accessories above. Craft Molten Armor at a Hellforge from Hellstone Bars + Obsidian. Farm Hellstone using an Obsidian Skin Potion or Obsidian Skull/Horseshoe combo so lava doesn't kill you. Use Ironskin and Regeneration potions for the Wall of Flesh.

title: Pre-Hardmode Ranged
summary: Strong single-target and crowd control from range; ammo economy matters early.

weapons.label: Minishark — cheap, high fire-rate clear weapon (Arms Dealer)
The Bee's Knees — Queen Bee drop, strong bow upgrade
Star Cannon — Sky Crate drop, top-tier pre-Hardmode boss weapon

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — no knockback + fire immunity
Cloud in a Bottle — extra jump
Hermes Boots — movement speed
Band of Regeneration — passive healing
Magic Quiver — arrow damage/velocity, chance to not consume arrows
Philosopher's Stone — faster potion cooldown

notes: Full loadout: Necro Armor set + Star Cannon (Sky Crate farming) or Minishark for general clearing, plus the 6 accessories above. Necro Armor pieces come from Skeletron (Headgear) and Shadow Orbs/Crimson Hearts (Breastplate, Greaves). Stock Musket Balls or Meteor Shots and keep max distance during the Wall of Flesh fight.

title: Pre-Hardmode Mage
summary: Highest burst potential pre-hardmode but mana-hungry; strongest against Wall of Flesh with Space Gun spam.

weapons.label: Water Bolt — cheap mana, strong early dps (found underground)
Space Gun — infinite ammo, no mana cost with Meteor set bonus
Flamelash — Underworld drop, strong hallway damage vs Wall of Flesh

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — no knockback + fire immunity
Cloud in a Bottle — extra jump
Hermes Boots — movement speed
Band of Regeneration — passive healing
Mana Flower — auto-drinks mana potions, +magic damage
Nazar — cures Confused debuff, small stat stepping stone toward Celestial Shell

notes: Full loadout: Meteor Armor set + Space Gun as your primary (the set bonus reduces its mana cost to 0, making it free infinite damage), plus the 6 accessories above. Craft Meteor Armor from Meteorite Bars after a Meteorite crash lands. Stock mana potions as backup for Water Bolt/Flamelash bursts.

title: Pre-Hardmode Summoner
summary: Weakest pre-hardmode class but still viable with careful positioning; hybridize with another weapon type.

weapons.label: Slime Staff — reliable early summon (Slime drop)
Optic Staff — Queen Bee drop, strongest pre-Hardmode summon
Minishark — secondary damage source while your summon works (Arms Dealer)

accessories.label: Obsidian Shield — no knockback + fire immunity
Cloud in a Bottle — extra jump
Hermes Boots — movement speed
Band of Regeneration — passive healing
Philosopher's Stone — faster potion cooldown

notes: Full loadout: Bee Armor set + Optic Staff as your main summon, plus the 5 accessories above. Bee Armor and Optic Staff both come from Queen Bee — farm the Bee biome before Skeletron. Summoner is genuinely weak pre-Hardmode; lean on Minishark or another secondary weapon for damage and keep moving during the Wall of Flesh fight since summons don't need line of sight.

title: Early Hardmode Melee
summary: Push through Cobalt → Mythril → Adamantite/Titanium ore tiers to gear up for your first Mechanical Boss.

weapons.label: Cobalt Sword — first Hardmode melee weapon tier
Excalibur — Hallowed Bar sword, strong pre-Mech-Boss upgrade
Adamantite Sword (or Titanium Sword) — goal weapon before your first Mechanical Boss attempt

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Warrior Emblem — flat melee damage boost
Titan Glove — melee knockback
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Adamantite Armor (or Titanium, whichever ore your world generated) + Adamantite/Titanium Sword, plus the 5 accessories above. This is the practical gear ceiling before fighting your first Mechanical Boss — Cobalt/Palladium and Mythril/Orichalcum are just stepping stones through this tier, so don't over-invest time in them. Craft the Ankh Shield from the full Ankh Charm before your Mech Boss attempt. Stick to one metal type per armor tier since set bonuses require a full matching set.

title: Early Hardmode Ranged
summary: Push through Cobalt → Mythril → Adamantite/Titanium ore tiers to gear up for your first Mechanical Boss.

weapons.label: Cobalt Repeater — first Hardmode bow-tier weapon
Shotgun — strong short-range burst (Golden Lock Box)
Adamantite Repeater (or Titanium Repeater) — goal weapon before your first Mechanical Boss attempt

armor.label: Adamantite Headgear (or Titanium Headgear) — ranged-focused helmet piece

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Ranger Emblem — flat ranged damage boost
Magic Quiver — arrow damage/velocity, ammo conservation
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Adamantite Armor (or Titanium) with the ranged Headgear piece + Adamantite/Titanium Repeater, plus the 5 accessories above. Ranged scales cleanly through Hardmode ore tiers — keep upgrading repeaters and buy any craftable guns as soon as you can afford them, then push all the way to Adamantite/Titanium before your first Mech Boss.

title: Early Hardmode Mage
summary: Push through Cobalt → Mythril → Adamantite/Titanium ore tiers to gear up for your first Mechanical Boss; Golden Shower is a standout weapon.

weapons.label: Golden Shower — strong DoT weapon with a defense-reducing debuff, your main goal weapon for this stage
Crystal Storm — Cobalt-tier magic weapon
Rainbow Rod — Corruption alternative to Golden Shower

armor.label: Adamantite Headgear (or Titanium Headgear) — magic-focused hat piece

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Sorcerer Emblem — flat magic damage boost
Mana Flower — auto-drinks mana potions, +magic damage
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Adamantite Armor (or Titanium) with the magic Headgear piece + Golden Shower as your main weapon, plus the 5 accessories above. Golden Shower's defense-reduction debuff makes Mechanical Boss fights noticeably easier for your whole team, not just you. Push all the way to Adamantite/Titanium gear before your first Mech Boss attempt.

title: Early Hardmode Summoner
summary: Summoner comes online hard in Hardmode — Spider Armor and Spider Staff are a huge power spike.

weapons.label: Spider Staff — massive pre-Plantera summon upgrade (Spider biome)
Optic Staff — carries until Spider Staff is farmed
Adamantite Repeater (or Titanium Repeater) — secondary damage source

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Summoner Emblem — flat summon damage boost
Necromantic Scroll — extra summon damage
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Spider Armor set + Spider Staff, plus the 5 accessories above. Spider Armor and Spider Staff both drop in the underground Corruption/Crimson Spider biome — this combo is considered one of the strongest single power spikes in the entire game for summoners, so prioritize farming it as soon as Hardmode starts.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Melee
summary: Hallowed gear and yoyos carry into Plantera.

weapons.label: True Excalibur — Excalibur + Broken Hero Sword combined at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
Amarok — strong pre-Plantera yoyo (Ice biome)
Flairon — post-Plantera goal weapon (Dungeon + Plantera loop farming)

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Fire Gauntlet — melee speed, knockback, and extra fire damage
Warrior Emblem — flat melee damage boost
Yoyo Bag — extends yoyo range, only useful if using a yoyo
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight

notes: Full loadout: Hallowed Armor set + True Excalibur, plus the 5 accessories above. Fight Plantera in the Jungle for Chlorophyte access, then farm Turtle Armor from the Jungle's Turtles once Chlorophyte ore is available as your follow-up armor set.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Ranged
summary: Hallowed gear and Hardmode guns carry into Plantera.

weapons.label: Uzi — strong Hallowed-tier automatic weapon
Tactical Shotgun — Mechanical Boss drop, top pre-Plantera shotgun
Sniper Rifle — high single-target dps, good vs Plantera

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Ranger Emblem — flat ranged damage boost
Magic Quiver — arrow damage/velocity, ammo conservation
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Hallowed Armor (ranged Headgear) + Sniper Rifle or Tactical Shotgun, plus the 5 accessories above. Sniper Rifle's high single-shot damage handles Plantera's bulb and tanky phases well; keep Tactical Shotgun or Uzi for general clearing. Chlorophyte gear becomes your follow-up after Plantera drops Chlorophyte ore access.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Mage
summary: Hallowed gear and strong AoE/DoT spells carry into Plantera.

weapons.label: Bat Scepter — strong summon-hybrid magic weapon
Rainbow Rod — long-range piercing projectile, good vs Plantera
Nimbus Rod — passive AoE raincloud, strong crowd control

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Sorcerer Emblem — flat magic damage boost
Mana Flower — auto-drinks mana potions, +magic damage
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Hallowed Armor (magic Headgear) + Rainbow Rod as your main damage dealer, plus the 5 accessories above. Nimbus Rod is excellent for passive damage during the Plantera chase phase since it doesn't require aiming. Chlorophyte gear becomes your follow-up after Plantera drops Chlorophyte ore access.

title: Post-Mechanical Bosses → Plantera Summoner
summary: Hallowed gear and stronger minions carry into Plantera.

weapons.label: Blade Staff — strong pre-Plantera summon (Hallowed biome)
Sanguine Staff — Crimson alternative to Blade Staff
Pygmy Staff — post-Plantera goal summon

accessories.label: Ankh Shield — immunity to nearly every debuff + no knockback
Summoner Emblem — flat summon damage boost
Necromantic Scroll — extra summon damage
Frostspark Boots — movement speed + flight
Band of Regeneration — passive healing

notes: Full loadout: Hallowed Armor set + Blade Staff (or Sanguine Staff), plus the 5 accessories above. Spider Armor is still viable here if you haven't upgraded past it — Hallowed Armor's boost is smaller for summoners than for other classes, so don't feel pressured to rush the swap. Pygmy Staff and Spooky Armor become your follow-up goal after Plantera.
